name: second-brain-kit
description: Notes and a tracker of open work for Claude Code, set up by Claude (not an official Anthropic plugin). Basic: one main session in a numbered notes folder, the tracker Claude keeps (each item closed with evidence), a done-check that logs, safety hooks that ask before deleting or uploading, and a growth loop: a hook reminds Claude to record each correction and confirmation in a note, and a light weekly review turns them into preferences after your yes, read before every task. Claude suggests the Full parts (two fixed sessions, entry and maintenance, plus topic sessions the entry opens and sends work into, a weekly learning review, reminders, outside resources split by kind of work) one by one from where you get stuck, and you confirm; a weekly check offers more on pain signals, only with your yes. Comes with short general working principles, 15 starter preferences you can delete (tagged as from the original author) and four general skills (evidence-check, outward-docs, blind-three-way, full-reader). Needs a Claude plan that includes Claude Code.
